what: Carry over when the salsa port lands: removed the dead bool parameter assert_placeholder_ty_is_unused (every caller passed false; when true a placeholder layout was size 0 align 1 instead of its LayoutError). Signatures: HirDatabase::interpret_mir (trait + impl, crates/hir-ty/src/db.rs) and the providers fn type (crates/hir-ty/src/providers.rs) lose the bool; hir_ty_mir eval::interpret_mir, Evaluator::new, Evaluator::with_machine lose it; the Evaluator field and its branch in size_align_of are gone, and the now-unused LayoutError import in eval.rs. Files: crates/hir-ty/src/db.rs, crates/hir-ty/src/providers.rs, crates/hir-ty/src/next_solver/coroutine_witness_tests.rs, crates/hir-ty/src/consteval/hir_eval.rs, crates/hir-ty-mir/src/mir/eval.rs, crates/hir-ty-mir/src/mir/providers.rs, crates/hir-ty-mir/src/mir/eval/macro_call.rs, crates/hir-ty-mir/src/tests/mir/eval.rs, crates/hir-ty-mir/tests/mir/foreign.rs, crates/hir/src/lib.rs, crates/hir-ty-codegen/mod.rs, crates/hir-ty-codegen/v2/refs.rs, crates/hir-ty-share/src/walk.rs, crates/blaze-macro-eval/src/run.rs. Also in hir-ty: crates/hir-ty/src/mir.rs PlaceTy::projection_ty(_core) now panics (as rustc bug!) on a place type that does not normalize and on Deref/Index of a non-pointer/non-array, instead of a silent error type.

history.note: already in blaze-v2-qu: merges from blaze-v2 brought the change and the replay keeps it; rg assert_placeholder_ty_is_unused in crates/ finds nothing
